theme: Light theme preferred for healthcare trust and cleanliness, with a clean structural grayscale base.

headings.rationale: Friendly, approachable yet highly professional. Perfectly suits modern Indonesian tech platforms.
styles: h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900
h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800
labels: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500

body.rationale: High legibility for dense medical records (SOAP notes), vital signs, and tariffs.

rules: No teal green/blue (#1B93A4) as per forbidden rules. We use Emerald Green and Ocean Blue.
Never use pure black or pure white for long-form text backgrounds. Use tinted greys (Slate).
Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 APCA contrast ratio.

marketing_landing.structure: Bento Grid (Mode A) with organic asymmetry.
marketing_landing.spacing: Generous (p-8, p-12, p-24) to let content breathe.
marketing_landing.hero: Clear value proposition with a warm, trusted image. Maximum overlay bg-black/40 if placing text over images.

patient_dashboard.structure: Bento Grid (Mode A) to prioritize immediate needs: Search Provider, Ongoing Booking, Medical Records.
patient_dashboard.spacing: Medium to tight (p-4 to p-6) with clear card separation.

nakes_dashboard.structure: High Density Grid (Mode B) for task-first focus (Incoming orders, SOAP form, Vital signs input).
nakes_dashboard.spacing: Dense (p-4, gap-4) ensuring quick data entry and readability.

admin_dashboard.structure: Sidebar + High Density Grid. Focus on tables, verification queues, and transaction monitors.

cards.style: Flat background, 1px solid border-slate-200, no drop-shadow by default.

buttons.style: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or moderately rounded (rounded-xl) for friendliness.
buttons.interaction: Clear hover state with text color explicitly set (hover:bg-emerald-700 hover:text-white).

forms.style: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. For medical inputs, use clear labeling and dense layout.
forms.rule: Never use native <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn Calendar component.

navigation.style: Sticky header with crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200) for marketing, solid background for dashboards.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Medical apps require flat solid surfaces instead of heavy glassmorphism to prevent visual refraction of clinical data.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the landing page hero for a premium feel. Dashboards should remain perfectly clean.

rules: Subtle micro-interactions on hover (opacity and slight transforms).
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., booking accepted, payment successful).
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='book-provider-btn').
Focus states must have a clear ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500).
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all UI animations.

icons.rationale: Clean, consistent, and pre-installed with Shadcn.

hero_nurses.description: Female nurse in uniform, representing trust and care.
Nurse smiling with elderly patient in room.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a complex multi-role app (Patient, Nakes, Admin) for the Indonesian market. Text and labels must be in Bahasa Indonesia.
Use standard Shadcn components (Cards, Tables, Dialogs, Select, Forms) but customize their paddings and borders to fit the defined 'Flat solid surfaces' style.
Implement Google Login + Email auth UI (mocked logic or Firebase if instructed).
Implement QRIS, Cash, and Stripe payment mockups in the patient booking flow.
For the Nakes dashboard, the SOAP (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan) and Vital Signs forms must be cleanly laid out using Shadcn Forms.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use responsive grid configurations (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) for service cards and provider lists.
Do not use HTML default <select> or <input type='date'>. Always use Shadcn Dropdown/Select and Calendar.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Avoid simplistic gradients and uniform styling.
Do not apply 'transition: all' globally. Explicitly define transitions.
Do not center align the root app container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the curated Unsplash images provided in the guidelines.
Ensure generous spacing to prevent cramped designs, especially on mobile devices.
